title: Sega Arcade Gallery
sources: own RAM search with gbaverify (no RA notes): in After Burner the HUD score 80000 -> 112000 -> 144000 -> 168000 is stored /10 as a u16 at 0x030027AC, the stage 1 -> 2 -> 3 at 0x030027B0

rows: Super Hang-On, OutRun, After Burner, Space Harrier

Each game keeps its own options (difficulty, controls) on its own title screen
